67 likes, 233 comments - mombae.blogger on October 12, 2026: "Comment GAMES for the link

Apparently, turning 7 comes with a VERY long wishlist! 😂🎁

Aarna has been spotting toys everywhere — on Amazon, at her friends’ homes, and all over the internet — and adding them to her ever-growing list of things she wants. 🎀

So here’s Part 2 of her wishlist, featuring everything from quirky gadgets and fun games to creative kits and toys that make you go, “Okay, even I want to try this!” 😂

If you have kids between 4 and 7, consider this your little cheat sheet for birthday gifts, Christmas presents, or those days when you have absolutely no clue what to buy a child.

Bonus: The Amazon Great Indian Festival Sale is on, and several of these are available at some really good discounts! 🛍️

Want the links to everything on her wishlist? Comment WISHLIST and I’ll send them your way. 💌

Save this for your next toy-shopping emergency! 😅

Follow for more tried and tested recommendations!

#KidsGiftIdeas #ToyWishlist #GiftIdeasForKids #AmazonFinds #AmazonSale".
